Precautions to be Adopted on January 28, 1942 -
Anniversary of the Sino-Japanese Incident (1932)

There is no indication at present to show that any
demonstrations or organised disturbances will take place in
the Settlement on January 28.

No additional barricades will be erected, but Divisional
Officers will take all possible precautions with the forces at
their disposal to prevent an incident.

Detectives will be fully employed to make discreet en-
quiries at hotels and lodging houses re recent arrivals.

The Reserve Unit will stand by ready for call at immediate
notice.

No monthly leave will be granted on January 28, 1942.

CHIN
                                    H. Robertson.

第 412 号。
分区警务官通告（供知悉）    档案    1942年1月24日。
                                        5-92
                                      26 / 42

1942年1月28日应采取的预防措施——
“一·二八”事变（1932年）周年纪念日

目前尚无迹象表明，1月28日租界内会发生任何示威或有组织的骚乱。

不会增设额外的路障，但各区警官将利用其可支配的警力采取一切可能的预防措施，以防发生事端。

侦探将被充分部署，对旅馆和寄宿舍近期入住人员进行谨慎查访。

后备队将待命，以便在接到即时通知时随时出动。

1942年1月28日不批准任何月度休假。

陈
                                    H. Robertson.
